text:
Mira: FYI SolaraTech (acct SOL-948) - invoice INV-2026-118 is past due for $62,400. CC auth failed on retry. Customer offered a partial wire of $30,000 today and wants the remainder in two installments. They asked us to waive the $750 late fee and pause dunning while we finalize. @Dan @Sofia @Alex can we confirm next steps?
Dan: pulling the ledger now. I see a $1,200 credit from Feb applied to a different invoice; won't auto-net here without approval.
Sofia: customer reported a 36-hr outage in their prod last week; they say the downtime impacted their payment cadence. They've sent an email promising wire once we confirm acceptance.
Alex: before waiving fees need to confirm contract doesn't prohibit split payments. I'll check the T&C quick.
collections-bot: Automated reminder sent to SolaraTech on 2123456700 for INV-2026-118 (due 2026-03-11). Status: delivery confirmed.
Dan: proposal: accept $30k wire today, create a two-installment plan for $16,200 each with auto-invoice on 30/60 days, require an email agreement from customer and PO from their procurement. If legal signs off we can apply the $1,200 credit to reduce remaining balance.
Mira: sounds reasonable. I'm inclined to waive the late fee if wire clears by EOD and they sign the installment agreement. That pauses dunning for 30 days. Any objections?
Alex: contract allows installment arrangements with written consent from both sides; legal ok if we: 1) document plan in an email or simple addendum, 2) require a PO or signed note, 3) add a 1.5% monthly interest clause if >60 days. For this case, no interest if paid within 60 days.
Sofia: I'll ask the customer for a PO and confirmation email now. Suggested email text: `We confirm acceptance of a $30,000 wire today with the remaining $32,400 split into two equal payments on 2026-04-10 and 2026-05-10. Please sign and return.` Want me to cc finance?
Mira: yes cc @Dan. Dan - once I see proof of wire, I'll approve waiving the $750 late fee and mark invoice as paused.
Dan: noted. Action items: Sofia to get PO/email, customer to send wire confirmation, Finance to post wire and apply credit, Legal to sign off on addendum if needed. I'll prepare the installment invoice schedule.
Sofia: pinging SolaraTech now. I'll paste their reply here when they send the PO.
collections-bot: Action logged: hold-dunning-tag applied to INV-2026-118 by Mira at 2123456820 (pending wire).
Mira: thanks. If wire posts and everything signed I'll close this thread and update billing. If any hiccup escalate to execs. :thumbsup:
Sofia: they just emailed PO# SOL-PO-772. Attaching proof of payment once they send SWIFT confirmation.
Dan: got it. I'll wait for SWIFT and then post receipts and update ledger.
Mira: approval given contingent on wire received today — waive late fee and pause dunning. Otherwise resume normal collections tomorrow AM.
Alex: legal acknowledges contingency. Leaving note in contract tracker.
Sofia: customer confirmed wire initiated, reference WIRE-SOL-0321. Forwarding SWIFT when received.
Dan: received SWIFT at 2123456845 for $30,000, reference matches. Posting now and applying $1,200 credit to remaining balance. New outstanding after wire: $31,200. Invoice status: Partially Paid / Payment Plan drafted.
Mira: marking as resolved pending signed email addendum. Great work team. :tada:
